claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if NVIDIA disposes of or converts-and-sells the Series A Preferred position, or if subsequent filings show the strategic partnership terminated or materially narrowed.
claims.statement: NVIDIA completed a $2.0 billion cash purchase of 2.0 million shares of Marvell Series A Convertible Preferred Stock on March 31, 2026, initially convertible into a maximum of approximately 21.8 million common shares at approximately $91.84 per share.

claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if either party announces termination or material narrowing of the partnership, or if custom XPU / scale-up networking products fail to reach production under the partnership scope.
claims.statement: Marvell and NVIDIA announced a strategic partnership in Q1 FY2027 to connect Marvell custom XPUs and compatible scale-up networking with NVIDIA's AI infrastructure ecosystem.

claims.disproof_condition: Reassess if amended warrant terms create binding minimum purchases or the warrants are cancelled; the claim describes incentive direction, not program economics.
claims.statement: Marvell separately grants warrants to customers (Fiscal 2025: up to 4.2 million shares at $87.77; Fiscal 2026: total grant-date fair value $55.4 million, none vested as of August 1, 2026) that vest on the customer's revenue milestones and are recognized as a reduction to revenue — a supplier-pays-customer incentive direction that coexists with, and must not be conflated with, NVIDIA's customer-side capital commitment.

source_doc.title: Marvell 10-Q (Q2 FY2027) — NVIDIA $2.0B Series A Preferred investment and strategic partnership

sources.locator: Note 10 Stockholders' Equity, Series A Preferred issuance
sources.quote: On March 31, 2026, the Company completed the issuance and sale of 2.0 million shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.002 per share (the “Series A Preferred Stock”), to NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”), for an aggregate purchase price of $2.0 billion.

During the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Marvell and NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”) announced a strategic partnership to connect our custom XPUs and compatible scale-up networking with NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure ecosystem.

Each share of Series A Preferred Stock has a stated value of $1,000 and is initially convertible, at the option of the holder, into shares of the Company’s common stock at an initial conversion price of approximately $91.84 per share into an aggregate maximum of approximately 21.8 million shares of common stock
the Company issued a warrant to a customer for the purchase of up to 4.2 million shares (“Fiscal 2025 Warrant Shares”) of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $87.77 per share

sources.locator: Revenue note, customer warrant vesting mechanics
sources.quote: The Fiscal 2025 Warrant Shares vest primarily based on the customer’s achievement of qualifying product revenue milestones and are recognized as a reduction to revenue as qualifying revenues ar

sources.locator: Revenue note, Fiscal 2026 warrant fair value
sources.quote: The grant date fair value of the warrant was determined to be $53.02 per share and a total fair value of $55.4 million using the Black-Scholes option pricing model. None of the Fiscal 2026 Warrant Shares have vested as of August 1, 2026.
